evidence: Scope: Title and opening paragraph; Kinesis and several dependent services (Cognito, CloudWatch, Lambda, EventBridge, ECS, EKS) were disrupted across the Northern Virginia region. End: Kinesis and CloudWatch paragraphs; Kinesis was normal at 10:23 PM PST, yet CloudWatch metrics and alarms only fully recovered at 10:31 PM PST.
notes: End left empty: the report gives only service-by-service recovery times (Kinesis normal 10:23 PM PST = 2020-11-26T06:23Z; CloudWatch fully recovered 10:31 PM PST = 2020-11-26T06:31Z, then backfill over subsequent hours) and no whole-event end statement; CloudWatch stayed impaired after the Kinesis time, so that time is not the event end.

evidence: Scope: Opening paragraph; Direct Connect traffic into the Tokyo region was affected, with no limit to one zone; other regions unaffected. End: Opening and response paragraphs; at 1:42 PM JST connectivity problems were cleared and the service was back to normal operations.
notes: Report states times in JST (UTC+9); 1:42 PM JST on 2021-09-02 converted to 04:42Z. The report says both fully resolved and returned to normal operations; coded impact_ended for the restored-service statement. Engineers disabled the protocol in one Availability Zone first, but impact is described for the Tokyo region as a whole.

evidence: Scope: AWS Service Impact section; control-plane APIs for launching and managing resources, console sign-in and other services failed in Northern Virginia. End: Issue Summary and service paragraphs; network devices recovered at 2:22 PM PST, but STS, API Gateway, Fargate and EventBridge kept problems for hours.
notes: End left empty: no whole-event end statement. Network devices fully recovered 2:22 PM PST (2021-12-07T22:22Z), but EC2 launches recovered 2:40 PM, STS 4:28 PM, API Gateway largely 4:37 PM with low errors for several more hours, Fargate 5:00 PM, EventBridge latency until 6:40 PM PST; building an end from these parts is not allowed.

evidence: Scope: Issue Summary; Lambda invocations and dependent services such as STS, console, EKS, Connect and EventBridge degraded in the Northern Virginia region. End: Issue Summary; by 3:37 PM PDT every affected service had fully recovered.
notes: 3:37 PM PDT (UTC-7) on 2023-06-13 converted to 22:37Z. The window from 1:45 PM to 3:37 PM PDT included asynchronous backlog processing; the report does not state that customer impact ended before the backlog, so the whole-event statement at 3:37 PM PDT is taken. Impact was within one Lambda cell, which is not a zone.

evidence: Scope: Summary of Impact and Mitigation; some users in North America saw Graph API timeouts, and traffic moved to other healthy North American regions. End: Title and Summary of Impact; the issue is marked mitigated, with impact ending at 17:30 UTC.
notes: Scope unclear: no affected region is named and the report does not say how many regions were affected; North America is a geography, and the report does not say all its regions were affected. End basis mitigated because the report title labels the event only as mitigated.

evidence: Scope: Summary of Impact; SQL Database connections and App Service management operations failed in West Europe, with no limit to a zone. End: Summary of Impact; the impact window closes at 15:31 UTC on 16 Feb 2022.
notes: Azure times are in UTC; no conversion needed.

evidence: Scope: Root Cause; the workload surge hit one unnamed affected region, causing sign-in and sign-up errors for B2C end users there. End: Summary of Impact; the error window ends at 10:22 UTC on 16 March 2022.
notes: The report refers to a single affected region but does not name it, so no region code exists; coded regional because the report states one region, not zone-limited. Times in UTC.

evidence: Scope: Title and Summary of Impact; service management calls failed for many services across East US 2, though the trigger began in one zone. End: Summary of Impact; impact window closes at 14:40 UTC on 09 Apr 2022.
notes: The fault began with a zonal Allocator failure, but customer impact was region-wide management operations, so coded regional. Times in UTC.

evidence: Scope: Title; the review is labelled as affecting multiple regions, with no regions named. End: What happened; the impact window ends at 03:30 UTC on 13 Aug 2022, when the hotfix completed.
notes: Scope from the title's multiple regions without names. The response section adds that customers reported success shortly after the 03:30 UTC hotfix completion, but gives no later time; the stated impact window end is taken. Times in UTC.

evidence: Scope: What happened; West Europe traffic and many services were hit, and Azure Databricks also had impact in North Europe. End: How did we respond; loss rates normal at 07:25 UTC, but dependent services recovered only afterwards, with no time given.
notes: Scope multi_region because two regions were impaired (westeurope, plus Databricks in northeurope), although the customer guidance calls it a single-region incident. End left empty: the 07:25 UTC window end is for network loss rates, and the report says dependent services recovered shortly thereafter without a stated time, so impact went on after 07:25 UTC and no later whole-event moment is given.
